d:
Doug Rediker, managing partner at International Capital Strategy, says the market correction is helping “rationalize and normalize” the AI thesis after a period of heavy investment and rising financing risk, calling the pullback both necessary and healthy. He also says geopolitical uncertainty is becoming increasingly difficult for markets to quantify, but adds that he is “not as upset as some otherwise might be” about the risks. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power."
